newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU concerned about situation in Belarus.
newsitem.headline: EU concerned about situation in Belarus.

text.p: The European Union expressed serious concern on Thursday about the situation in Minsk following the signing of a political union treaty between Russia and Belarus.
"We are currently studying the text of the treaty for a fuller response but meanwhile we are concerned about the situation," said European Commission spokesman Thierry Daman.
Calm returned to the capital of Belarus on Thursday after thousands of people marched on Wednesday night to protest against the treaty.
Belarus critics of the accord fear it will water down national soverignty and may eventually rob the country of its short-lived independence.
The Union Treaty is intended to deepen integration between the vast Russian Federation of 150 million people and its smaller and less wealthy western neighbour of just 10 million.
Many ordinary Russians and Belarussians, impoverished by economic reforms, are nostalgic for the Soviet Union which collapsed in 1991.
